Step:  
08-26-1404 is August 26, 1404.  
21 weeks and 1 day = 21×7 + 1 = 148 days earlier.  
1404 is a leap year (divisible by 4 in Julian calendar).  
August 26, 1404 minus 148 days:  
Go back 26 days to August 1.  
Remaining 122 days earlier:  
July has 31 days → back 31 to July 1 → 91 left.  
June 30 → 61 left.  
May 31 → 30 left.  
April 30 → 0 left.  
So land on April 1, 1404.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1404-04-01
